title: Warm Creamy Malaysian Chicken Curry
description: A savory and festive Malaysian dish featuring chicken in a rich and creamy curry sauce, flavored with vanilla pod and served with deep-fry-tod, this recipe is a low-calorie-friendly version of a classic dish. It is perfect for special occasions or everyday meals.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and vanilla pod and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the deep-fry-tod and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
